items.t: High-voltage battery modules can overheat (recall)
items.job: Battery monitoring software and module replacement (recall 23V-867)
items.note: Free at Audi dealers. Parts shortages have delayed some repairs.

items.t: Coolant leaks into front electric motor
items.job: Replace front electric drive motor and coolant seals/hoses
items.note: Usually covered by the 8-year/100,000-mile high-voltage warranty. One owner reported being told about $15,000 per motor.

items.t: Sudden loss of drive power with electrical malfunction warning
items.note: Diagnosis only; owners report fixes ranging from software to a new motor or controller, which are usually covered by the 8-year/100,000-mile high-voltage warranty. YourMechanic lists an electrical inspection at about $105–$140 (e-tron S).

items.t: Brake pedal can come loose from the brake booster (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair brake pedal-to-booster fastener (recall 24V-621)

items.t: 240-volt portable charging cable can overheat (recall)
Water can enter battery through charging socket seal (recall)
Brake booster weld defect reduces braking assist (recall)
Brake booster corrosion can disable ABS and stability control (recall)
Dead 12-volt battery, car won't wake up or start
items.note: Diagnosis only; the fix may be a new 12-volt battery, a software update, or finding a module that stays awake. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $95–$132 for 2019–2022 models.

items.t: Car won't charge or charge port won't release the cable
items.note: Diagnosis only; Audi uses software updates and charge-port parts depending on the cause. YourMechanic lists an electrical inspection at about $105–$140 (e-tron S).

items.t: Low coolant warning or coolant leak
items.job: Find coolant leak or false warning
items.note: Diagnosis only; the fix may be a sensor, an electric coolant valve or a coolant top-up. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $95–$132 for 2019–2022 models.

items.t: Air suspension fault warning or car sitting low
items.job: Replace leaking air strut or air suspension part
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average of about $1,300 for a failed suspension.

items.t: Clunk or rattle from rear axle over bumps
items.note: Diagnosis only; the repair depends on which part is loose or worn. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $95–$132 for 2019–2022 models.

items.t: Squeak or creak from front suspension
items.note: Diagnosis only; the repair depends on what the shop finds. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $95–$132 for 2019–2022 models.

items.t: Infotainment unit fails and rear camera goes dark (recall)
Rearview camera image may not appear, software fault (recall)
Rearview camera shows black screen (recall)
Screens or virtual cockpit go blank or flicker
items.job: Diagnose display fault and update software
items.note: Diagnosis only; some cases are fixed with software, others need a new display or module. YourMechanic lists an electrical inspection at about $105–$140 (e-tron S).

items.t: No sound from audio system
items.note: Diagnosis only; Audi's bulletin replaces a failed audio control module on early 2019 cars, which may be covered under warranty. YourMechanic lists an electrical inspection at about $105–$140 (e-tron S).

items.t: Battery module controller (SX6) failure
items.job: Replace high-voltage battery module control units (SX6)
items.note: One owner was quoted over $8,000 at a $345/hour dealer rate. Check the 8-year/100,000-mile high-voltage warranty first.

items.t: Car rolls on hills even in gear
items.note: Diagnosis only; the fix may be a setting, software or a brake system part. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $95–$132 for 2019–2022 models.

items.t: Red steering warning light
items.note: Diagnosis only; the fix depends on the stored fault codes. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $95–$132 for 2019–2022 models.

items.t: Glove box hinge pin can block knee airbag (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure glove box hinge pin (recall 21V-595)

items.t: Rear seat belt may not hold a child seat (recall)
items.job: Replace rear center seat belt assembly (recall 21V-606)

items.t: Brake line connection can leak fluid (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace brake pressure line (recall 24V-428)
